verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm. Its evidence covers legal advisory practices plus questionnaire-driven document generators (Contract Express, DocuSign, HighQ deal room), none of which is an API platform. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for agents is a category error for this kind of professional-services product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability; the probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
